title: rorippa indica subsp. benghalensis
intro: Rorippa indica subsp. benghalensis, commonly known as Bengal watercress, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is known for its edible leaves, which have been used in traditional medicine for their health benefits. The leaves of Rorippa indica subsp. benghalensis have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and prevent the formation of blood clots. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects.
